title: Branding and sign-in
description: Configure branding for this tenant portal. Save a draft, then publish separately.
previewOnly: Visual preview only. No credentials will be submitted.
previewEmpty: Edit the draft, then select Preview sign-in.
previewSize: Preview width: {width}px. Scroll horizontally to inspect the desktop layout.
primaryColorHint: Six-digit hex color, such as #6853bd. Decorative only; action text contrast is preserved.
uploadHint: PNG, JPEG or GIF, up to 2 MiB each. Publication produces static PNG; only the first GIF frame is kept.
uploadInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or GIF image of up to 2 MiB.
assetSelected: Image configured; preview to inspect it
legacyBackground: This portal retains a migrated background. Upload a replacement or choose Hide/Inherit and save to replace it. Historical publications stay unchanged.
publishConfirm: Publish the saved draft to the sign-in page and administration?
rollbackConfirm: Create a new publication using this historical content? The current draft will be preserved.
saved: Draft saved. It has not been published.
rolledBack: Rollback published. The draft is unchanged.
unknown: The last write result is unknown. Check its result before continuing; writes are never retried automatically.
notObserved: No committed receipt observed yet. The original request may still be running. Check again later.
conflict: Remote data changed. Your local edits are preserved; review before loading the remote draft.
loadRemoteConfirm: Loading the remote draft will replace your local edits. Continue?
savedMatched: The original save completed. The current draft has been reloaded.
unknownLeave: An operation is unconfirmed. Keep its operation ID and check the result first.
previewStale: Preview is outdated. Generate a new preview.
previewFailed: Preview failed. Check fields and image permissions.
legalHint: Legal owners and registration numbers never inherit the platform legal identity.

directory.tenantDescription: Platform operators register tenants and manage directory status. Server authorization applies to every action.
directory.domainDescription: Manage domain ownership, DNS, TLS and primary entries for each tenant.
directory.provisioningHint: Registration creates a directory entry only. Business databases, migrations and initial accounts are not provisioned automatically. Complete deployment preparation before activation.
directory.registrationHint: Registration reserves ownership. After ownership, DNS and TLS checks pass, explicitly enable the domain.
directory.domainDetailHint: Registration, network verification and activation are separate actions. Ownership and portal cannot be reassigned in place.
directory.name: Tenant name
directory.invalidTenant: Code must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64 characters. Name is required, up to 128 characters.
directory.invalidDomain: Enter a hostname without scheme, port or path. Portal must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters.
directory.statusConfirm: Set tenant “{name}” to “{status}”? Existing authentication material will be invalidated. Activation does not provision business resources, and retirement cannot be reversed.
directory.stateMatched: The original operation has been checked and the current state reloaded.
directory.notConfirmed: The intended state has not been confirmed. This does not prove the request was not committed. Check again or contact platform operations.
directory.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Check it before submitting again. Leaving does not cancel server work.
directory.leaveUnknown: Leaving will not cancel the server operation. Keep the object and operation ID, and reconcile before starting another action. Leave now?
directory.dnsHint: Add this TXT record in your DNS console, wait for propagation, then run the check.
directory.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
directory.verificationDisabled: Deployment ingress addresses are not configured. Network verification is unavailable.
directory.activationHint: Passing verification does not enable the domain. Activation also requires an active tenant and valid evidence. Disabling invalidates this tenant's existing sessions.

confirm.challenge: Generate a new TXT challenge for {hostname}? The old challenge and in-flight check will be superseded. Valid historical evidence for an active entry is retained.
confirm.verify: Check ownership, DNS and TLS for {hostname}? A successful result still requires explicit activation.
confirm.enable: Enable {hostname} as a login entry for this tenant?
confirm.disable: Disable {hostname}? This tenant's existing sessions will be invalidated and will not return after re-enabling.
confirm.primary: Make {hostname} the primary domain for this tenant and portal?

failures.NOT_CONFIGURED: Deployment ingress addresses are not configured.
failures.INVALID_DOMAIN: The domain or challenge format is invalid.
failures.BUSY: The network verification concurrency limit was reached.
failures.OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH: The DNS TXT record does not match the current challenge.
failures.DNS_NOT_ALLOWED: Resolved addresses are outside the ingress allow-list or exceed the address limit.
failures.TLS_FAILED: TLS trust, hostname or validity checks failed.
failures.TIMEOUT: The check deadline, lease or challenge expired.
failures.CONFIG_CHANGED: Configuration changed; the old result cannot be applied.
failures.INTERNAL_ERROR: The check did not finish normally. Reconcile and contact platform operations.
